selection_reasoning: The player must first locate a room/area identified by light_blue_carpet, which serves as a landmark guiding them to the correct location. Once the light_blue_carpet area is found, the player can locate and mine the dark_oak_sign placed nearby in that same area. This creates a natural navigation-then-interaction chain: find the landmark first, then perform the mining action at that location. Both tasks are observable, verifiable, and don't require deep Minecraft expertise — finding carpet is visual recognition, and mining a sign is a basic interaction.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate to and visually identify the light_blue_carpet patch. The carpet occupies spawn-relative coordinates (5,0,-9) to (9,0,-6), so the center target is (7, 0, -7). max_distance=16 allows the player to 'find' it from a reasonable viewing distance across the courtyard, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the carpet, confirming visual identification rather than just passing nearby.

Uses inventory_has because mining a dark_oak_wall_sign drops a 'dark_oak_sign' item into the player's inventory. This is the preferred rule for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory, so any dark_oak_sign present (min_count=1) confirms successful mining. No special tool is required — signs break instantly with bare hands.

scene_description: An open-air courtyard with stone brick perimeter walls (2 blocks high) and a smooth stone floor. The courtyard is divided by two parallel cobblestone walls running north-south with a gap for passage. Four colored carpet patches mark the four quadrants: light_blue in NE, red in NW, yellow in SW, lime in SE. Wall signs are mounted on the perimeter walls: dark_oak_wall_sign on the north wall near the light_blue_carpet (NE quadrant), with distractor signs (oak, birch, spruce) on other walls. Sea lanterns embedded in the floor provide additional lighting.
task_text: Find the light blue carpet area in the courtyard, then mine the dark oak sign on the wall near it.
design_notes: Player spawns in center corridor between two cobblestone walls. Gap at z=-2 allows passage north. NE quadrant (x=5-9, z=-9 to -6) has light_blue_carpet on floor. Dark_oak_wall_sign at (7,1,-12) on north perimeter wall faces south (visible from NE quadrant). Three distractor signs and three distractor carpet colors in other quadrants. Sea lanterns under floor for supplemental lighting. Open sky ensures daylight.
